answer: Every new agent locks a pearl bond of 200 POA in escrow for 20 epochs, refunded after clean service. An atlas maps every referral edge, so 100 clones by one operator form a star cluster around one hub. When a zephyr of fresh accounts arrives on one hub, any peer may dispute the cluster; if upheld, all 100 pearls are slashed, half to the challenger. Forging 100 identities costs 20,000 POA, while an honest agent pays once and earns fees.
